# Leaflet 1.9.4

Vendored unchanged from the pinned npm distribution on 2026-09-08:

- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet-src.esm.js
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/
- https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/LICENSE

The source, styles and standard image assets are bundled locally so the map library can load without a CDN. See `LICENSE` for the BSD 2-Clause licence. Basemap imagery is supplied separately and has its own attribution and provider terms.
